# `mcp`

`mcp` is not a Rius namespace. Rius defines only the keys below
in it, each under a documented namespace exception; every other
`mcp` key Rius uses is upstream's (see [upstream keys](upstream.md)).

## Attributes

| Key | Stability | Type | Description | Examples |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| <a id="mcp-result-type"></a>`mcp.result_type` | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | Result type of an MCP tools/call round that ended with an interim result instead of a final one. [1] | `input_required` |

## Notes

**[1] `mcp.result_type`:** MCP spec 2026-07-28: a tools/call round can end with an interim
"input_required" result (MRTR) instead of a final one. Set ONLY on interim
rounds. NOT an OTel semconv attribute, unlike the two above: the key
borrows the mcp SDK's own `mcp.*` spelling for its result-type field, and
no convention defines it. Kept as-is because the backend reads it.

Namespace exception: Predates the rule. The key borrows the mcp SDK's own `mcp.*` spelling for
its result-type field, and the backend reads it under this name.
